items.title: Obtain Chattanooga and Hamilton County business licenses
items.description: Businesses need a city license and a Hamilton County license; business tax returns are filed with the Tennessee Department of Revenue, and renewals may not be mailed as a notice.

feeDetail.note: The tax depends on the business classification and gross receipts; the minimum for classifications 1 through 4 is $22 per license.

penalty.note: A city renewal notice describes the state rule: 5% per month or part of a month, up to 25% of the tax, with a $15 minimum, plus interest.

note: Licensing runs mainly through the Montgomery County Clerk; no official city page confirmed a separate city license.

items.title: Review applicable local licenses and permits in Clarksville
items.description: Review the cited local licensing source before operating; requirements may be activity-specific and can differ by business type or location.

feeDetail.note: The fee depends on the type of business and license; the city or county sets it in its fee schedule.

penalty.note: This entry covers the city's local licenses and taxes generally, each of which carries its own late charge in the municipal code; no single amount is stated.

items.title: Obtain Knoxville and Knox County business licenses
items.authority: City of Knoxville Business License/Tax Office
items.description: A business in Knoxville needs a city license and a county license from the Knox County Clerk, and pays annual business tax to the Tennessee Department of Revenue.

feeDetail.note: The business tax depends on the classification and gross receipts, so no single amount applies.

penalty.note: The city's published pages for this item give no late-penalty amount.

items.title: Obtain Memphis / Shelby County business license
items.authority: Shelby County Clerk, Business Tax Division
items.description: Register with the County Clerk within 20 days after the business starts to receive a business license, and report gross receipts annually to the Tennessee Department of Revenue. A final return is due within 15 days of closing.

feeDetail.note: The business tax depends on the classification and gross receipts, so no single amount applies.

penalty.note: The city's published pages for this item give no late-penalty amount.

items.title: Obtain Murfreesboro and Rutherford County business licenses
items.description: Businesses in Murfreesboro need both a city license and a Rutherford County license, with an initial fee for each; businesses at $100,000 or more in gross receipts file with the Tennessee Department of Revenue.

feeDetail.note: An initial fee applies for each of the city and county licenses; the amounts depend on the business.

penalty.note: The city's published pages for this item give no late-penalty amount.

items.title: Obtain Nashville / Davidson County business license
items.authority: Davidson County Clerk, Business Tax Division
items.description: Businesses in Nashville-Davidson County obtain a business tax license or a minimal activity license from the County Clerk. The license fee is $30 for a business inside Nashville city limits (Urban Service District) and $15 outside city limits but within Davidson County. Report gross receipts to the Tennessee Department of Revenue with the annual business tax return.

penalty.note: The city's published pages for this item give no late-penalty amount.
